utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m not sure yet, but I can check the details while I’m out running errands and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, that would help a lot—just send me the time when you find it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—I’ll take a quick look and see what I can help with.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo—that would really help. Just let me know what you find, and I’ll keep the list updated.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’ll check it out and get back to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help line things up around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got the tools if you need them—just tell me the time and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Gus — I’m checking the school calendar now and I’ll send you the time as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a bit worried about the timing and who’s handling the pickup, but I can help if we keep the route simple.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, let’s keep it simple—I'll repeat the pickup plan to everyone and make sure the route stays easy.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps a lot. If you send me the pickup details once more, I’ll make sure I’m at the right spot on time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Rey, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—want me to put your name down or swing by later with the details?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, swing by later with the details—I’d like to take a look first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ll swing by later with the details and you can take a look first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help coordinate the repair drive and connect everyone’s groups. Just point me to the next thing that needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great — the next thing is to post the sign-up sheet at the community center and the corner market. If you can handle that, I’ll keep track of the addresses and pickup spots.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll post the sign-up sheet at both spots and let you know once it’s up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can help connect folks and keep the repair drive moving. What’s the next thing you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re still on for helping with the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, I’m still on for it — happy to help however you need.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I do anything—what exactly needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mostly the broken porch step, the flickering hallway light, and that leaky kitchen faucet. If you can help with any of those, that’d be a huge relief.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’ll start with the porch step and check the light and faucet details next.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting started soon, but I’m still piecing together the details. Do you know what they need help with?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I think they’re mainly looking for hands-on help with fixing up small things and maybe organizing supplies. I’m a bit fuzzy on the rest, but I can check later.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, thanks—I’m happy to help with whatever they need, even if I’m still catching up on the details.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Hana — I can lend a hand and bring over any tools we need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — could you bring the wrench set and a flashlight? I want to make sure we’ve got the right tools before we head over.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll grab the wrench set and a flashlight and bring them over.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting a nice little turnout—folks are dropping off tools and supplies already. If you need anything specific, I can keep an ear out.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s kind of you, Tess. I’m mostly just grateful folks are showing up at all.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It really does warm the heart, doesn’t it? If I hear anyone mention a need list, I’ll pass it your way right away.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit scattered, but I can help if you tell me what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Noah — I’m tracking the drop-off at the community center on Maple, and we still need the tools and spare cords. If you can bring either, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, got it — tools or spare cords, right? I can swing by and bring whatever I can find.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what’s the current status on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m still sorting a few things out, but it’s moving along, I promise.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good to hear. What’s still left to sort out?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard the full details yet, Rosa, but I’m glad to help if there’s a repair drive going on.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Rey — thank you. I’m still putting the final details together, but I’ll make sure you get the full repair drive info as soon as it’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Rosa. Just let me know when it’s ready, and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Sam — could you help spread the word and maybe collect a few donations or sign-ups? I’ll send you the details right now.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — send me the details, and I’ll start spreading the word and gathering a few donations or sign-ups.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, I’m a little late—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No worries, Dane. We’re still on for the repair drive—just meet me at the curb at 10, and we’ll load the donations together.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll meet you at the curb at 10 and help load the donations.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a running list of supplies for the repair drive—just tell me what you still need, and I’ll check what we have.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m running a bit late as usual, but I can help—what’s still on the list?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Dane — we still need screws, a couple hammers, duct tape, and some extension cords. If you can grab any of those, I’ll mark them off.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — could you bring a drill, a box of screws, and some gloves? If you’re free, I’d also love help sorting the donated tools when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can bring the drill, screws, and gloves, and I’ll help sort the donated tools when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can bring it by later, if that still helps.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, yes please—that would still help a lot. Thank you, Uli.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Of course. I’ll drop it off later today.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m in—what time should I bring the tools for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — can you bring them around 10? I’m sorry, I’ve been a bit all over the place.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure thing — I’ll bring the tools around 10. No worries, see you then.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a simple plan for the repair drive—what needs doing first, and when should we get started?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Let’s start by listing the repairs and gathering the tools, then we can begin this Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday morning works for me. Let’s list the repairs first so we can get everything ready.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re still sure the repair drive is happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, it’s still on for today. I’ll swing by with the tools.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, good — just wanted to make sure before I head out.
